biggest_catch: The $30 bonus is a 100% rebate on $30 of groceries or gas you were already going to buy at Sam's — but the card only makes sense if you already pay for a Sam's Club membership ($60/year), so do that math first.
catches: Only pursue this with spending you already planned (groceries, gas, household goods); never buy extra to hit the $30.
Card has no annual fee, but a paid Sam's Club membership ($60/year as of 2026) is mandatory — the $30 bonus does not cover a full year of membership.
Qualifying purchases exclude cash advances, gift card sales, alcohol, tobacco, and pharmacy purchases.
Rewards come as Sam's Cash, capped at $5,000 per calendar year, and gas 5% is capped at the first $6,000 per year (then 1%).
Carrying a balance at ~20%+ APR destroys the $30 bonus many times over; pay in full every month.
Hard credit inquiry required; Synchrony Bank pulls your credit when you apply.

eligibility: Must be a Sam's Club member with a membership number in your name.
Subject to credit approval by Synchrony Bank.
Newly opened accounts only; each account is eligible for only one $30 offer.
Qualifying purchases: Sam's Club purchases totaling $30 or more within 30 days of account opening, excluding cash advances, gift card sales, alcohol, tobacco, and pharmacy purchases.

The payout quote below is the samsclub.com consumer-card text. The Synchrony PDF supplies the verbatim full terms (approval required; exclusions; credit posts within 90 days; one offer per account; issuer may alter or discontinue). Physical card arrives in 7-10 business days. The card is issued by Synchrony Bank. Annual fee: $0 for the card; membership paid separately. Never invent numbers.
payout_quote: Get a $30 statement credit when you open an account and use it to make $30 in eligible Sam's Club purchases within 30 days.
steps: Open the official Sam's Club credit card page on samsclub.com and confirm the $30 statement credit offer is still advertised before applying.
Confirm you already hold (or are willing to pay for) a Sam's Club membership in your name — it is required to apply.
Apply online at SamsClub.com or in-club; Synchrony Bank will run a hard credit check.

Within 30 days of account opening, make at least $30 in eligible Sam's Club purchases on the new card — use groceries or gas you already planned to buy (gift cards, alcohol, tobacco, and pharmacy purchases do not count).
Pay the balance in full; do not carry it.
Track the $30 statement credit — it should post within 90 days after the qualifying purchases.
timing: Credit appears within 90 days after the qualifying purchases are made.
